candidates.generation: Original LT, pre-MQ (documented in 2018 US catalog)

fieldNotes.generationEvidence: Daiwa's manufacturer-authored 2018 US catalog labels this BLSLT family NEW BALLISTIC LT. The catalog is viewed on Westernbass; not a retailer-authored spec table. This is the conventional ZAION-body generation, not BLSMQ/BALMQ/BAMQ.
fieldNotes.capacityEvidence: 2018 table explicitly labels Mono Capacity (Lb. Test/Yards). No manufacturer diameter is published here; diameter remains null. Braid is omitted rather than importing ratings from a different market.
fieldNotes.secondarySourceLimit: The original 2020 manufacturer PDF URL now returns 404, but its search-indexed exact rows corroborate these numbers. The live 2018 catalog mirror is the usable primary source.
fieldNotes.useCaseBasis: Editorial size-based application, not first-hand testing or a manufacturer rating.
fieldNotes.handEvidence: Reversible screw-in spinning handle; no separate handed variants proposed. Handle-cap configuration is visible in the exact-family image.
fieldNotes.imageEvidence: HTTP 200 image/jpeg; visually inspected. Image visibly reads BALLISTIC LT 2500D-XH despite retailer URL naming 1000D. Marked family-representative except for 2500D-XH.

duplicateCheck.reason: No BLSLT records. Existing BALMQLT records are named Ballistic MQ LT and are not renamed or treated as new regional SKUs. This candidate has independently documented pre-MQ construction and exact US identity.

fieldNotes.capacityEvidence: Pound-test/yards units corroborated by the manufacturer-authored 2025-26 catalog. No diameters inferred.
fieldNotes.handEvidence: Fisherman's Central lists Right/Left across this family; numeric specifications remain manufacturer-sourced.
fieldNotes.useCaseBasis: Official page explicitly describes live and natural bait fishing.
fieldNotes.imageEvidence: Official image returned HTTP 200 image/jpeg and was visually inspected. Spool label ECLTBR3000-C is a family representative; source feed's model spelling remains ECLTBR3000.

duplicateCheck.reason: No Emcast/ECLTBR family or SKU in either input. Free Swimmer is an existing, separately named bite-and-run family, not an Emcast alias.

candidates.editorialFeatureSentence: Its ATD TYPE-L drag is designed for responsive startup and smooth line release when a fish runs.

fieldNotes.conversion: oz = g / 28.349523125; lb = kg / 0.45359237; in/turn = cm/turn / 2.54. Results rounded to four decimals; capacity stays in original meters.
fieldNotes.generationEvidence: Official Japan table explicitly labels 25CALDIA FC LT1000S and JAN 4550133442414. JAN is the manufacturer product identifier used as sku; not a fabricated US-style code.
fieldNotes.capacityEvidence: Official header explicitly distinguishes nylon (lb-m) from PE (size-m). Nylon is recorded as mono. PE number is not pound-test or diameter. No diameter or fluorocarbon capacity is assigned, and no Nordic diameter rating is blended into this JDM record.
fieldNotes.featureEvidence: Official page confirms only AIRDRIVE rotor, bail and spool, not AIRDRIVE shaft. ATD TYPE-L applies to smaller models; the two 5000 sizes use ATD TOUGH.
fieldNotes.handEvidence: Reversible family configuration corroborated by JDM Tackle Heaven; no separate LH/RH rows created. Dealer numeric capacities are not used.
fieldNotes.useCaseBasis: Concise editorial paraphrase of the official model-specific intended-use section; no first-hand testing claim.
fieldNotes.imageEvidence: Exact JAN/model-named image linked on the same Japan product page. All 27 JDM image URLs returned HTTP 200 image/jpeg; one image per family visually spot-checked.

duplicateCheck.reason: No Caldia family or JAN match in either input. Current 25CALDIA has a documented ZAION V MQ body and 6+1 bearings; not a renaming of the existing uncertain BALMQLT XH records. FC/body size, shallow spool and gear suffix remain separate. Regional marketing duplicates are held, not separately proposed.
